name: Diglipur
description: Diglipur is the largest town in North Andaman, offering an offbeat adventure far from touristy crowds. It is famous for Ross & Smith Islands (two islands joined by a natural white sandbar), Saddle Peak (the highest point in Andamans), and Kalipur Beach's turtle nesting grounds.

name: Long Island
description: Long Island is a transient, car-free island in the Andaman archipelago. Surrounded by coconut groves and tropical forests, it is famous for Lalaji Bay Beach (a pristine crescent beach reached by a boat ride or forest trek) and its slow, peaceful island way of life.

name: Bharatpur Beach Neil Island (Shaheed Dweep)
description: Located adjacent to Neil Island Jetty on Shaheed Dweep, celebrated for expansive shallow white sands, calm turquoise waters, and vibrant live coral reefs teeming with colorful tropical clownfish, sea anemones, and giant clams.

name: Cellular Jail National Memorial Port Blair
description: Constructed by the British between 1896 and 1906, a formidable seven-winged panopticon prison known as 'Kala Pani', where prominent Indian freedom fighters like Veer Savarkar and Batukeshwar Dutt were exiled and subjected to solitary confinement.
